motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council instruct the General Services Department, in coordination with El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument Authority Commission, to provide a report on the lease agreements of El Pueblo. The report should include rent amounts and arrears, the duration of each rental agreement, as well as how many parcels are vacant and how they market the lease of those spaces. The report should include details such as the City’s approval role, legacy arrangements, Request For Proposal processes and contracting formalities. I FURTHER MOVE that the Council instruct the General Services Department (GSD) to report who is responsible for maintaining each property and making improvements according to the lease agreements. This report should declare how many GSD repairs there are each year and the average time it takes to close a repair ticket. PRESENTED BY lAlo YSABEL JURADO Councilmember, 14th District / — FEB 0 6 2026 SECONDED BY
